title: Conflict Minerals Policy
content_html:
CONFLICT MINERALS POLICY

INTRODUCTION:

At Ultimate Laser, we are committed to ethical and responsible business practices that prioritize human rights, environmental sustainability, and social welfare. We recognize the importance of addressing the issue of conflict minerals and their potential link to human rights abuses and environmental degradation. This policy outlines our commitment to avoiding the use of conflict minerals in our products and supply chain, as well as our dedication to promoting responsible sourcing practices.

SCOPE:

This policy applies to all employees, suppliers, contractors, and partners associated with Ultimate Laser, and it covers all products and services offered by the company.

POLICY STATEMENT:

Ultimate Laser is committed to the following principles regarding conflict minerals:

Avoidance of Conflict Minerals:

We will not knowingly use conflict minerals in the manufacturing of our products. Conflict minerals include tin, tantalum, tungsten, and gold, sourced from regions that directly or indirectly finance armed conflict, human rights abuses, and environmental degradation.

Supply Chain Transparency:

We will maintain transparency within our supply chain by collaborating with our suppliers to ensure they provide information on the origin of minerals used in our products. We will work to identify the smelters and refiners in our supply chain and prioritize those that have been certified as conflict-free by recognized third-party organizations.

Responsible Sourcing:

We will make reasonable efforts to source minerals from suppliers who share our commitment to responsible sourcing practices. We will favor suppliers that adhere to international guidelines and standards, such as the OECD Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Supply Chains of Minerals from Conflict-Affected and High-Risk Areas.

Supplier Engagement:

Ultimate Laser will actively engage with our suppliers to communicate our conflict minerals policy and expectations. We will work together to identify and address any potential risks related to conflict minerals in our supply chain.

Risk Assessment and Due Diligence:

We will conduct regular risk assessments to identify and assess the potential use of conflict minerals in our supply chain. Where there is a risk, we will implement due diligence measures to ensure the minerals used in our products are sourced responsibly and do not contribute to conflict or human rights violations.

Continuous Improvement:

We are committed to continuously improving our efforts to eliminate the use of conflict minerals from our products. This includes staying informed about industry best practices and evolving international standards.

REPORTING AND COMPLIANCE:

Ultimate Laser will maintain records of our conflict minerals due diligence efforts and communicate our progress through our annual sustainability reports. We will comply with any reporting requirements established by regulatory authorities.

CONCLUSION:

At Ultimate Laser, we firmly believe in our responsibility to contribute to a more just and sustainable world. This policy reflects our commitment to avoiding the use of conflict minerals and promoting responsible practices throughout our supply chain. By adhering to these principles, we strive to make a positive impact on both the communities we operate in and the broader global landscape.

This policy is effective immediately and will be reviewed periodically to ensure its relevance and effectiveness.

title: Forklift Policy
content_html:
FORKLIFT POLICY

Purpose:

Ultimate Laser is committed to ensuring the safety of its employees and visitors. This Forklift Policy outlines the guidelines and procedures for the safe operation of forklifts within the company premises.

Scope:

This policy applies to all employees, contractors, and visitors operating forklifts on Ultimate Laser premises.

Policy:

Travelling Speed: Forklifts must adhere to a maximum speed limit of 5 km/h while operating within the company premises.

Horn Usage: Operators are required to sound the horn when entering and exiting buildings to alert pedestrians and other vehicles of their presence.

Speeding: Speeding beyond the designated limit will not be tolerated. Any instances of speeding will result in disciplinary action, which may include warnings, fines, or suspension depending on the severity of the violation.

Seatbelt Usage: Operators must wear seatbelts at all times while operating a forklift, regardless of the distance travelled or the task being performed.

Restricted Areas: Only registered forklifts are permitted to cross Micro Circuit within the company premises. Unauthorised forklifts are strictly prohibited from entering this area.

Safety Gear: Employees responsible for loading and unloading tubes from Factory 6 are required to wear hard hats while performing these tasks. This applies to both loading and unloading procedures to ensure the safety of personnel.

Responsibilities:

Management: Ultimate Laser management is responsible for enforcing this Forklift Policy and ensuring compliance with all safety regulations.

Operators: Forklift operators are responsible for adhering to the guidelines outlined in this policy and conducting pre-operational checks to ensure the forklift is in safe working condition.

Supervisors: Supervisors are responsible for monitoring forklift operations within their areas of responsibility and addressing any safety concerns or violations promptly.

Training: All forklift operators must undergo comprehensive training and certification to operate forklifts safely. Refresher training should be provided periodically to ensure operators remain competent and up-to-date with safety protocols.

Incident Reporting: Any incidents, near misses, or safety concerns related to forklift operations must be reported immediately to the relevant supervisor or safety officer for investigation and corrective action.

Enforcement: Failure to comply with this Forklift Policy may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, depending on the severity and recurrence of the violation.

Review and Revision:

This policy will be reviewed regularly to ensure it remains current and effective. Any necessary revisions will be made in consultation with relevant stakeholders to improve safety standards and practices.

Conclusion:

Ultimate Laser is committed to providing a safe working environment for all employees and visitors. By adhering to this Forklift Policy, we can minimize the risk of accidents and injuries associated with forklift operations. Your cooperation and compliance with these guidelines are essential for maintaining a culture of safety within our organization.
